# Seat audit (generated by tools/design/world/depth_seat_audit.py)

Fit test R4: first base lean >= 25 % (or the seat's top element), other base leans >= 15 % (or in the top two), variant leans >= 5 variant qi. Candidates: places of the sect's own ground (great: its territory; minor: its lord's territory in the seat's region), not another sect's seat, best first. Density is the place's qi density (the current seat's in the header).
**37 of 50 seats fail the fit test.**
